benchmarkSequence.rationale: ITTC lists DTMB model 5415 as a combatant benchmark with towing-tank and free-surface datasets and extensive past use.

usvApplicationGate.rule: No candidate-USV CFD resistance result becomes agent-usable validation evidence until at least one controlled ITTC benchmark campaign has passed its source-defined numerical and experimental-correlation criteria.
